entry_points.text: CPUID change discards root and guest validity and nested walks, rebuilds context, requires updates still allowed. Reset unloads and rebuilds.

Flush accounts, publishes, tries arch then broadcast, accounts done. Broadcast walks online vCPUs, records, wakes, kicks together. IPI via mode flip. Requests order stores then bit. Write unplug needs locks, decs count, restores pages when active.

exports.text: Boot fills size table from hardware upward from vector start. Sizing adds header plus components, 64B align for flagged in compacted mode.
Queries give guest width with 36 fallback, reserved bits above width, and max guest width or zero via extended leaves.
Exposes per-vCPU Hyper-V pointer from arch area. Inline setter with vCPU and flag has no effect here.
Unload frees active plus guest roots and clears MMIO, warning if valid left. Free picks by mask, skips lock when none, frees and resets, read for TDP else write.

hazards.text: Generic queries must avoid lazy dynamic caps, build-rejecting three, wait allowed.
Zap commit holds write, commits list, flushes TLBs before freeing, validates invalid with no refs and clean entries.

invariants.text: Scan returns first function match, needing index when significant; sentinel gives first but warns once for indexed fns. Miss absent. Bad selector warns, zero. Emulated index zero only. Asserts IRQs on, linear.

Width 0/48/57 else reject, FP enables dynamic bits; equality needs same count and regs. Discovery matches sig across bases for base and limit or none. Quirk clears unhalt when HLT disabled. HLT in guest when disabled. Quirk on when bit enabled. Leaves 0,1,7,0xD,0x80000000,0x80000008.
Hyper-V false unless built with interface ID. Vendor from three words, AMD or Hygon. Masks combine halves with host, zero when absent. CR4 masks to guest bits, refreshes when stale, reports set.

Runtime flips same bit in entry and cache. Cache one word per leaf. Translation remaps few internal ids, leaf is word, bit low five, with checks. Mapping via descriptor to one of four regs, test and flip by mask. Host array per leaf, frequent-read, test bit.
Mask gives ones over inclusive 64-bit range, normalizing upper, zero when empty, build-checking constants.

Masks per leaf and depth from host bits plus XD and vendor, AMD versus EPT, encryption carve-out. EPT reserves high bits and gates huge pages. PSE36 true, AMD probe only with TDP. Permissions indexed by fault code, honoring WP/XD/SMEP/SMAP. PKRU zero when off, else checks user non-fetch with AD/WD rules.

Slot lookup retries cached slot then walks tree, updating cache, null on miss unless approx. Large pages via per-slot counters, write track per frame, restore on removal. Unaccount drops indirect counts and restores.

GFN via base, cache or index. Presence by mask. Zap drops mappings, detaches, recurses nested. Clear counts non-present; VE by config. Unsync clears. Obsolete if invalid or stale. Only shadowed own entries. Accounting frees. Bugs warn once.
External helpers for warnings, barriers, atomics, lists, cpumask, lockdep, strings, math and containers are outside D07 black boxes.

locks.text: Touch vCPU only locked or unreachable (negative index or zero users). Root teardown needs read for TDP else write, queues zap on last invalid ref.

state_machines.text: Version combines base plus count and directed EOI when extended and suppressed, stored or skipped off-kernel. Broadcast always, never, or quirked via IOAPIC mode, else warn and deny. IOAPIC in kernel via full check; LAPIC normally in kernel.

After set rebuilds caps from host and guest, refreshes runtime, fixes large pages via hardware when caching, updates timer shift 17, masks, vendor, limits, counters, Hyper-V and interceptions. Runtime syncs leaves 1,7,0xD with live CR and APIC state.
Records enable, warns without struct, clears cache, exits when off, else mirrors enlightenment leaves.

Init builds role regs from CRs, folds to CPU role with SMM and guest flags, direct when paging off else leveled with protections. Refreshes walk, picks TDP or shadow unless nested. Paging on with depth, PAE unless short. Flags from host word.

TDP keeps context when role unchanged, else stores role, picks fault handler, clears sync, refreshes tables. Root direct with protections and level. Depth from guest width or host max, forced wins else max with shrink.

Shadow derives root and dispatches paging flavors, skipping when unchanged else refreshing handlers and tables. Walk caches role, installs callbacks, picks translators, rebuilds metadata. Zap unlinks children and parents, accounts, and retires empty pages.

structs.text: Descriptor holds three u32 per subleaf. Table one per feature, filled at boot then read-only.
